labels: A chao pao with a round neck, right-side closure and pleats below the waist has a separate shoulder cape and cuffs extending over the backs of the hands.; 둥근 깃·우임·허리 아래 주름이 있는 조포에 별도 어깨깃과 손등 쪽으로 길어진 소맷부리를 둔다.
definition: Optional court-scene visual realization: A chao pao with a round neck, right-side closure and pleats below the waist has a separate shoulder cape and cuffs extending over the backs of the hands.
